title: iGEM 2018 Interlab Study Protocol: Calibration 3
author: Ylenia Longo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qpadvie
materials: Transfer 100µl of 1x fluorescein stock solution from A1 to A2. Mix 3x by pipetting up and down. Then transfer 100µl from A2 to A3. Mix again 3x by pipetting up and down and transfer again 100µl from A3 to A4. Continue this procedure until arrived at well A11. Mix 3x by pipetting up and down and transfer 100µl into the LIQUID WASTE and NOT in A12. As replicates are performed, the same procedure is performed for row B, C and D as well.
Serial dilutions of fluorescein stock solutions

steps.title: Prepare fluorescein stock solutions
steps.instruction: Spin down the fluorescein kit tube, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of 1× PBS to create a 10× fluorescein stock, pipet up and down until no particulates are visible, then dilute the 10× stock 1:10 with 1× PBS (e.g., 100 µL 10× stock + 900 µL PBS) to obtain a 1× fluorescein stock solution.

steps.title: Add PBS to plate wells
steps.instruction: Pipet 100 µL of 1× PBS into wells A2–A12, and repeat the same volume for the corresponding wells in rows B, C, and D.

steps.title: Add fluorescein to plate wells
steps.instruction: Pipet 200 µL of the 1× fluorescein stock solution into wells A1, B1, C1, and D1.

steps.title: Measure fluorescence
steps.instruction: Set the plate reader to excitation 485 nm, emission detection 520–530 nm with a 30 nm bandpass centered at 520 nm, then record fluorescence for each well.

steps.title: Import data into Excel
steps.instruction: Open the iGEM‑provided Excel sheet, go to the ‘fluorescein standard curve’ tab, and import or paste the measured fluorescence data.
